name: team_planning_move_position
description: Move a position to another unit in a scenario of a Team Planning plan, keeping its role, level, FTE, basis, cost centre, hiring status and target start. The people in the position move with it. Written as one PositionSet. Refused on the baseline, and unless the caller is one of the plan's editors.

scenario_id.description: A scenario of the plan. Not the baseline.

to_unit_id.description: The unit the position moves to.
